shots.title: Maren at the rail, listening
shots.description: @maren-kest grips the rail of @the-vigil, head tilted. She hears it first.

shots.title: The lamps answer
shots.description: The green-white lamps of @the-vigil flare and settle, one by one, down the rail.

shots.title: Bray stops mid-story
shots.description: @bray-half-hitch on the stair, a story dying in his mouth as the water goes wrong.

shots.title: The harbour holds its breath
shots.description: From the rail: the whole harbour flat as glass, tide a hand-span too high against @the-saltmarket pilings.
